pages.text: Ground radar. A pulse shows buried ore, caves, metal and ORSA sites through the rock.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Survey$(): 30 kW, 48 blocks$(li)$(bold)Deep$(): 50 kW, 80 blocks$(br2)A pulse takes 10 s, then 60 s to recharge. It draws only while pulsing.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Link it with the $(l:power/binder)Binder$(/l). The grid and batteries must cover the full draw.$(br2)$(danger)If power dips mid-pulse, it aborts with no scan.$()

pages.title: Target
pages.text: Choose before pulsing:$(li)$(bold)All$()$(li)$(bold)Metals$(): iron, copper, gold, galena$(li)$(bold)Energy$(): coal, uranium$(li)$(bold)Minerals$(): the rest

pages.title: Rock
pages.text: Rays cross ice, snow and frozen ground farther than stone; deepslate cuts range. $(bold)Water stops them$().$(br2)$(danger)Each pulse is loud. Architects hear it.$()
Iron, a compass, redstone blocks, an amethyst shard and an iron block.$(br2)$(flavor)Point down. Listen.$()
